newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Revoz reaches accord with union.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Revoz reaches accord with union.

text.p: Trade union bosses at Slovenian car maker Revoz, a unit of France's Renault, said on Friday they had reached agreement with management on all their demands.
"We signed the final agreement on Thursday. It detailed changes in production, training and the transfer of some production managers," union leader Janez Jaksa told Reuters.
He said pay demands were met last Friday when Revoz agreed to increase salaries by eight to 14 percent.
The union held a one-hour strike on May 26, claiming conditions in the factory had worsened since Renault announced the closure of a plant in Belgium.
"The negotiations have already brought results and labour relations have improved since the strike," Jaksa said.
Prior to the pay deal the average net monthly salary of a production worker was between 50,000 to 55,000 tolars ($354),well below the Slovenian average of 89,234 tolars, Jaksa said.
-- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 155.4 Slovenian Tolars)
